scheme.name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
scheme.summary: PM SVANidhi is a central-sector micro-credit scheme to provide handholding support to street vendors, facilitating a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy.
scheme.benefits: The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy. To incentivize the adoption of digital transactions, a cashback of up to ₹100 per month is given to Street Vendors.
caveats: Applicant must be a street vendor in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by ULBs, OR identified in the survey but not issued the card, OR left out of the ULB-led identification survey / started vending after survey completion with an LoR from ULB/TVC, OR a vendor of surrounding development/peri-urban/rural areas vending in ULB geographical limits with an LoR from ULB/TVC
Survey Reference Number (SRN) is mandatory for online application
Applicant must be a vendor identified in the survey but not issued Certificate of Vending / Identity Card
Applicant must be a street vendor left out of the ULB-led identification survey or who started vending after completion of the survey and issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) by ULB/TVC
Applicant must be a vendor of surrounding development/peri-urban/rural areas vending in the geographical limits of the ULBs, issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) by ULB/TVC
documents: Copy of Membership Card/any other proof of membership
Any other document to substantiate the claim as a vendor
scheme.how_to_apply: Visit https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/ and click on the "Log In" button on the homepage. Enter Mobile number and captcha. Click request OTP. After successful login, select valid "vendor category" among the available options. Enter "Survey Reference Number" (SRN) which is mandatory. On entering these basic details, fill the application form online, upload the relevant documents and submit.
